FortiADC-KVM # config load-balance pool
  edit "POOL_APP"
    set health-check-ctrl enable
    set health-check-list HC_HTTP_APP
    set real-server-ssl-profile NONE
    config  pool_member
      edit 1
        set pool_member_cookie rs1
        set real-server RS_A
      next
      edit 2
        set pool_member_cookie rs2
        set real-server RS_B
      next
    end
  next
  edit "LAB_POOL_SMTP"
    set health-check-ctrl enable
    set health-check-list LAB_HC_SMTP
    set real-server-ssl-profile NONE
    config  pool_member
      edit 1
        set pool_member_service_port 25
        set pool_member_cookie rs1
--More--                  set real-server RS_A
      next
      edit 2
        set pool_member_service_port 25
        set pool_member_cookie rs2
        set real-server RS_B
      next
    end
  next
  edit "LAB_POOL_DNS"
    set health-check-ctrl enable
    set health-check-list LAB_HC_DNS
    set real-server-ssl-profile NONE
    config  pool_member
      edit 1
        set pool_member_service_port 53
        set pool_member_cookie rs1
        set real-server RS_A
      next
      edit 2
        set pool_member_service_port 53
        set pool_member_cookie rs2
        set real-server RS_B
      next
--More--              end
  next
  edit "netops-tlsca-pool"
    set health-check-ctrl enable
    set health-check-list netops-tlsca-hc
    set real-server-ssl-profile LB_RS_SSL_PROF_MEDIUM
    config  pool_member
      edit 1
        set pool_member_service_port 443
        set pool_member_cookie rs1
        set real-server netops-tlsca-rs
      next
    end
  next
end
